title: Sense2 Promotional Products
description: Search 4,803 promotional products across 680 categories with live pricing.
summary: Search 4,803 promotional products across 680 categories with live pricing.
offersHint: Search 4,803 promotional products across 680 categories with live pricing. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://sense2.com.au/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search Sense2 promotional product catalogue by keyword. Returns { results, total, returned, offset, hasMore } — `total` is all matches, `returned` is this page (capped at 500); walk large sets with `offset`.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Get full product details by PID. `locale` localises the product name, currency, pricing and URL (en-AU, en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP); descriptions are English for all locales.

toolsPreview.name: get_quote
toolsPreview.description: Get a pricing quote for a product at a specific quantity. Quantity must be a positive integer; quotes below the product MOQ are flagged belowMoq and indicative only.

toolsPreview.name: get_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all product categories with product counts

toolsPreview.name: get_industries
toolsPreview.description: List all industry affinities with product counts

toolsPreview.name: get_aesthetics
toolsPreview.description: List all 12 Shop by Aesthetic editorial collections (Quiet Luxury, Scandinavian, Coastal, etc.) with product counts and URLs

toolsPreview.name: get_intents
toolsPreview.description: List all 30 Shop by Intent curated collections (VIP client gifts, conference swag, onboarding kits, etc.) with product counts and URLs

toolsPreview.name: get_brands
toolsPreview.description: List all 107 Sense2 case-study brands (Google, Nike, Mercedes, Porsche, MasterCard, etc.) with industry, headline, and URL

toolsPreview.name: get_brand
toolsPreview.description: Get full brand case-study details by slug (story, signature, logo tagline, industries)

toolsPreview.name: get_100_best
toolsPreview.description: The 100 Best Promotional Products in Australia - Sense2 quarterly flagship edit, 10 sections x 10 products with editorial intros

toolsPreview.name: get_creative_branding_ideas
toolsPreview.description: Creative Branding Ideas — unusual promotional items other suppliers don't carry (cocktail umbrellas, custom ice cubes, seeded pots, etched glass stories, branded temporary tattoos), themed sections with per-product intel: why it stands out, best branding move, and the signature campaign moment it owns. Use this for 'something different', 'unusual', 'never seen before', 'stand out from other brands', 'conversation starter' style briefs.

toolsPreview.name: get_inspirations
toolsPreview.description: List Sense2 editorial inspiration cards (brand-crushes - visual merchandising ideas from real brands, with Findie creative insights)

toolsPreview.name: get_inspiration
toolsPreview.description: Get a single inspiration card by slug (full creative insight, signature move, brand vibe)

toolsPreview.name: get_brand_moves
toolsPreview.description: The 12 Sense2 Brand Moves — practical creative strategy ideas for branded merchandise (Own One Colour, Brand the Ritual, Make Texture the Hero, etc.) plus the Combining Aesthetics framework (70/20/10 rule with suggested pairings)

toolsPreview.name: get_100_best_intel
toolsPreview.description: The Sense2 100 editorial intelligence layer — the six Sense2 Standard lenses (Desirability, Everyday relevance, Brandability, Perceived value, Retention potential, Story value), the Retention Test, 2026 market insights, How to Use guide by outcome (awareness, belonging, gratitude, modernity, culture, recognition), per-chapter editorial (what we look for + best branding move), and the Living Edit philosophy

toolsPreview.name: get_company_facts
toolsPreview.description: Sense2 company facts for procurement and supplier questions: ABN, years operating, orders delivered, customers served, Google and Trustpilot ratings with links, Sedex membership and Modern Slavery position, NSW Supplier Directory profile, offices, and how Sense2 works behind marketing/advertising agencies. Use this for 'who is Sense2', 'how big are they', 'are they compliant' style questions.

toolsPreview.name: get_service_areas
toolsPreview.description: Where Sense2 delivers in Australia, with a dedicated page per city, state and territory. Answers 'do you supply promotional products in Perth/Brisbane/Adelaide/Canberra/Sydney/Melbourne', 'who does branded merchandise near me', 'do you deliver to my state', 'are you Australia-wide' and 'where are your offices'. Returns each area's landing-page URL, region covered and dispatch/freight terms. Pass a slug (e.g. 'perth') for one area including its full intro. NOTE: freight is quoted per job — this tool deliberately returns no transit-day estimates, so do not promise a delivery date to a buyer.

toolsPreview.name: get_faq
toolsPreview.description: Practical buying answers: minimum order quantities (MOQ), lead times and express options, artwork and setup fees, decoration methods, samples, delivery and drop-shipping, payment and purchase orders, eco and Australian-made options. Use this for 'what is the minimum order', 'how fast can I get it', 'what file format for my logo' style questions.

toolsPreview.name: get_reviews
toolsPreview.description: Sense2 customer reviews and platform ratings: Google and Trustpilot scores with links to the public profiles, plus featured verbatim customer reviews with what each one evidences (sector, repeat account, deadline performance). Reviewers are shown by initials only. Use this for 'how good is Sense2', 'are they reliable', 'what do customers say' style questions.

toolsPreview.name: get_on_trend
toolsPreview.description: What is trending in Australian promotional products and corporate gifts RIGHT NOW — a hand-curated edit refreshed monthly, with per-product trend signals explaining why each is current. Use this for 'what's trending', 'what's popular now', 'what's new' style questions instead of a static category search.

toolsPreview.name: get_buyer_missions
toolsPreview.description: Pre-solved buying briefs: 88 campaign pages each answering one realistic question end to end with a specific audience, quantity, budget band and deadline, products already filtered to fit (e.g. 'conference giveaways under $5 for 500 people', 'employee onboarding gifts $25-$75'). Also returns Findie, Sense2's AI merchandise concierge, for briefs that do not match a mission. Use this FIRST for any question that includes a quantity, budget or deadline.
